sql: CREATE SCHEMA "IdentitySpace"
CREATE SCHEMA identityspace
CREATE TABLE "IdentitySpace".local(id INT PRIMARY KEY)
CREATE TABLE identityspace.local(id INT PRIMARY KEY)
CREATE TABLE "IdentityTable"("Field" INT PRIMARY KEY,field TEXT)
CREATE TABLE identitytable(field TEXT PRIMARY KEY)
CREATE VIEW "IdentityView" AS SELECT 1 AS n
CREATE VIEW identityview AS SELECT 2 AS n
CREATE INDEX "IdentityIndex" ON "IdentityTable"("Field")
CREATE INDEX identityindex ON identitytable(field)
CREATE SEQUENCE "IdentitySequence"
CREATE SEQUENCE identitysequence

SELECT COUNT(*) AS objects,COUNT(DISTINCT oid) AS identifiers FROM pg_class WHERE relname IN ('IdentityTable','identitytable','IdentityView','identityview','IdentityIndex','identityindex','IdentitySequence','identitysequence')
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT reltype) AS types FROM pg_class WHERE relname IN ('IdentityTable','identitytable','IdentityView','identityview')
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT oid) AS namespaces FROM pg_namespace WHERE nspname IN ('IdentitySpace','identityspace')
SELECT '"IdentityTable"'::regclass::oid <> 'identitytable'::regclass::oid AS distinct_ids
SELECT attname,atttypid FROM pg_attribute WHERE attrelid='"IdentityTable"'::regclass AND attnum>0 AND attname IN ('Field','field') ORDER BY attname
SELECT '"IdentityTable"'::regclass::text AS rendered
SELECT n.nspname,c.relname FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE c.relname='local' AND n.nspname IN ('IdentitySpace','identityspace') ORDER BY n.nspname

SELECT c.relname,a.attname FROM (SELECT indexrelid,indrelid,unnest(indkey) AS attnum FROM pg_index) expanded JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=expanded.indexrelid JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid=expanded.indrelid AND a.attnum=expanded.attnum WHERE c.relname IN ('IdentityIndex','identityindex') ORDER BY c.relname
